description: List orders the authenticated principal placed (buyer-side view), paginated with a cursor. Optional status filter (e.g. 'paid_awaiting_fulfillment', 'delivered', 'cancelled'). Use this to find an order id before calling orders_get.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor in the previous page; omit for the first page.

status.description: Filter to a single order status; omit for all statuses.

name: orders_list
title: Orders list
